verdict.rationale: Docs reference a dedicated 'Migrate' page (MOLT migration overview) and PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility that would ease migration, but the evidence pack contains no actual detail on the migration process, minimal-downtime techniques, or step-by-step guidance. Missing for 10: concrete migration tool documentation (e.g. MOLT fetch/replicator steps), downtime/cutover guidance, and independent confirmation of successful production migrations.
